messages:
rachael (PM): Drafting PRD for staged routing + tenant routing tradeoffs. Need quick triage: customer-driven private deploys vs gradual exposure for hosted. Key asks: pinning by tenant, canary % rules, rollback triggers. Putting checklist below.

daniel (Eng): can you paste acceptance criteria? short bullets pls

rachael (PM): acceptance: 1) 0->100 ramp with canaries at 1/5/20/50/100, 2) pinned tenants must always hit requested model version until unpin, 3) <150ms p95 tail from edge -> model for hosted tier, 4) automated rollback if quality delta >3% or error rate >1%

maria (SRE): need SLOs for Dedicated too. p95 target differs, add ops runbook

josh (Product Eng): for experiment: A/B buckets: control (current routing) vs staged for new model, metric: user-facing latency, unit-cost, quality evals on sample prompts

alex (ML): define quality eval: use prompt-set v2 (1000 prompts) and measure exact-match + toxicity false positive. 3% delta on composite score triggers rollback

rachael (PM): edge cases: tenant with both pin and canary membership, tenant moves during rollout, KV cache invalidation, model variant mismatch

daniel (Eng): propose config snippet:
```
rollout:
  steps: [1,5,20,50,100]
  pin_mode: strict
  fallback: [preferred-variant, cheaper-quantized]
  rollback:
    quality_delta_pct: 3
    error_rate_pct: 1
```

maria (SRE): ops playbook snippet: alert thresholds, quick revert by toggling route weight to fallback, contact list

josh (Product Eng): experiments: run 2-week A/B, 50/50 split at step 5 for one week then 80/20 then roll

rachael (PM): customer ask: HIPAA tenant wants Private with immediate pin ability and SLA. Need to confirm KMS/HSM key separation and audit logs included

alex (ML): note: quantized variants can change hallucination profile — include human-review sample at each step

daniel (Eng): rollout automation tasks: feature flags, metrics plumbing (per-tenant), canary monitoring dashboard

maria (SRE): rollback criteria add: sustained QPS drop >20% or spike in 5xx >0.5% for 10m

rachael (PM): next: I'll update PRD and RFC with these bullets. If no blockers, we aim to land spec by EOD Thurs. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: deploy-checklist created: https://internal/boards/rollouts/1977777777

josh (Product Eng): +1
alex (ML): +1
maria (SRE): ack
